name: Script and verify remote factory worker launches
description:
Factory review recommendation 8 of 20.

## Context

The rook launcher-thread protocol repeatedly relies on agents reconstructing fragile shell and harness steps.

## Acceptance criteria

- Provide a launcher script that transfers the brief, starts the worker and verifies its actual identity.
- Check whether launch succeeded before retrying after an ambiguous response to avoid duplicate workers.
- Return a compact structured result and keep reusable skill assets self-contained; isolate rook-specific settings in repository configuration.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/137. Adds skills/rowbly-factory/scripts/launch-worker.mjs, assets/launcher.md and references/remote-launch.md. The script copies the brief to a T3 server, starts the worker through a reusable launcher thread and checks the result itself: one thread for the request, the requested provider, model and options, full-access in the project folder, and the brief as its first message. Each request (host, project and title, tied to its brief and model) has a receipt saved before the launch is sent, and reruns also check the launcher's earlier answers. So a rerun reuses the verified thread or refuses (conflict for an archived thread, unknown when the outcome can't be confirmed) and never starts a second worker; only a new title starts one. send delivers GO to a parked worker at most once. The live test on rook passed, and the real rerun of the archived test started 0 threads. The rook settings are proposed as ROWBLY.md text in the PR and are not committed. typecheck, lint, test:unit and test:cli all pass.
